name: aierix-cut-lead-engineer
description: Lead engineer for the AIerix Cut Android video editor: Kotlin/Compose/Media3 architecture, the Whisper Persian subtitle pipeline, debugging, testing and QA.

displayDescription.zh: 安卓视频编辑器首席工程师，精通 Kotlin、Compose、Media3，负责导出与字幕渲染。
